name: career-targeting-intelligence
description: Turns your background and search constraints into a prioritized map of verified jobs, target companies, relevant recruiters and engineering managers, evidence-based activity verification, and a manual outreach queue you review and act on yourself.

interface.longDescription: Career Targeting Intelligence is an evidence-based research assistant. Give it your background and search constraints and it builds a Candidate Profile, verifies open roles against employer sources, ranks target companies, finds relevant recruiters and engineering managers, and prepares a manual outreach queue. Every time-sensitive claim carries a cited source and a check date. It works from public professional information only and never monitors, scrapes, messages, or automates outreach on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: Here is my resume. Build my Candidate Profile.
Find verified open jobs that match my profile.
Rank these companies and explain the exclusions.
